summary: Our ambition should be to “enable 10 million new companies to raise capital,” Strategy’s executive chairman Michael Saylor wrote in an essay.

title: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
summary: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against prediction market Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee on regulating sports-event contracts under state laws.

title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
summary: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
summary: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.

title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
summary: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
summary: Former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger joined the Blockchain Association in 2025 after resigning during her second term at the federal commodities regulator.

title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
summary: US prosecutors alleged that a payments business illegally transferred hundreds of millions of dollars at the direction of EQIBank, where Tether holds some assets.
